findings.text: mincore entry validates that start is page aligned and that both the target range and the result vector are accessible to the caller, then processes the request in bounded chunks with a kernel bounce buffer, taking a read lock for each chunk, walking one mapping at a time, copying that chunk out, and advancing until all pages are reported or an error occurs.

brk entry serializes with a killable write lock, rejects addresses below the minimum and data-limit violations, treats same-page updates as a value store, shrinks by unmapping the tail with completion handling delegated to drop the lock, and grows only after area, lock-limit and neighbour-gap checks, optionally faulting the extension when future locking is enabled.

mlock family normalizes the address range to page boundaries, requires lock permission, checks the lock limit with overlap correction, applies per-mapping lock flags under a write lock, then faults the range and translates fault versus memory errors for POSIX reporting; mlock2 additionally accepts only an on-fault option that selects deferred locking, while munlock only clears flags.

mlockall validates flag combinations and permission, checks the whole address space size against the lock limit unless privileged or only future mappings are selected, updates default flags for future mappings and optionally all current mappings while tolerating per-mapping errors, then faults the whole user range when current mappings were requested; munlockall clears all lock selections.
Lock permission predicate reports success when the caller has any nonzero lock limit or the IPC lock privilege, otherwise failure.
Remote drain helper handles an offline processor by flushing its pending lock batch only when that batch holds entries.

Shared-memory lock accounting converts a byte size to pages, enforces the lock limit against per-user counters unless privileged, holds a reference on success, and provides a matching unlock that releases both the counter charge and the reference.

Future-lock limit check always passes for unlocked mappings or privileged callers, otherwise adds the requested bytes in pages to the accumulated locked total and compares against the resource limit in pages.
Unmap completion helper walks a private list of pending contexts, emits one unmap event carrying the recorded interval for each, waits for completion, then unlinks and releases each context.
Slot record links an address space owner into both a hash chain and a list, holding a node for hashing, a node for list membership, and a pointer to the address space.
Lock batch record pairs a per-processor local lock with a folio batch, instantiated once per processor with static initialization of the lock.
Two small bit values distinguish batch handling cases, one for reclaim-list members and one for newly allocated members.
Header guard macro marks inclusion of the slot header to prevent repeated inclusion.
Architecture map check defaults to success and logging uses a module-prefixed format; trace point creation is enabled for this unit.

Residency disclosure is gated: anonymous mappings are always walkable, mappings without a file that are not anonymous are rejected, and file mappings are walkable only when the caller owns the file or could open it for writing, otherwise a vector of present markers is returned without inspecting caches.

Residency is reported as one byte per page where set means resident and clear means not resident; huge directory entries and transparent huge pages report whole ranges as resident, present entries report resident with batching, empty or marker entries fall back to cache lookup, file holes consult page-cache state with special handling for swapped tmpfs values, anonymous holes report clear, and swap entries defer to a swap residency helper.
Single-mapping mincore lookup fails when no mapping covers the start, clamps the end to the mapping limit, and returns the number of pages actually examined.

Large folio locking policy always allows unlock and always allows small folios, but for locked mappings requires a large folio to be fully contained in the requested interval and fully mapped before it may be locked.

Locked accounting adjusts the address space total by the signed page count of each flag change, counting lock to unlock transitions negatively and ignoring transitions that were already locked, while limit enforcement subtracts already-locked overlap before comparing against the page-granularity limit.

Range flag application requires a fully covered contiguous interval, rejects gaps and overflow, treats empty ranges as success, and otherwise clears prior lock selections and installs the requested lock selection mapping by mapping.

Address-space randomization controls expose minimum, maximum and current entropy-bit settings for normal and compat modes, with current values marked as frequently read and one maximum marked as read-only after initialization; a separate boolean records whether the data limit is ignored.

Mincore page-table traversal runs under a read-mode walk lock; table entry handling takes the transparent-huge lock or the mapped table lock as appropriate, releases before continuing, and yields the processor after each range.

Lock and unlock traversal runs under a verified write-mode walk lock with per-entry huge and table locks released on every path; higher-level mlock, mlockall and brk operations hold the address-space lock in write mode, mincore holds it in read mode per chunk, and shared-memory user accounting is serialized by a dedicated spin lock.

Mincore iteration per chunk moves from lookup to permission fallback or table walk to copy-out and advance; zero or negative walk results terminate the loop and the final result reports success unless a copy or walk error occurred.

Flag fixup moves from no-change or unsupported bypass, to mapping split and flag install, to accounting update, to either direct flag store when already locked or a drained walk with a temporary marker that is cleared afterwards.

Table mapping races request a walk retry rather than failing; reclaim-list drains bracket lock walks; device-backed and zero huge pages are skipped; voluntary rescheduling occurs after ranges and between mappings to bound latency; unprivileged cache disclosure is avoided by the writability gate.
